name: Chijoku Idol Saki Haruka
original_name: 恥辱アイドル咲希はるか
source:
An alternate retelling of [url=/v12936]Zenra Toukou Shuukan Chijoku no Sanshuukan[/url]. After quitting her idol group Tears Haruka finds herself in a difficult situation. For breaking her contract she now owes a lot of money to her agency. Additionally her school is demanding she pay back the 3 years she didn't commit to doing Total Nude Scholastic's Week. Haruka is desperate, she cannot commit to returning to being an idol with tests coming up. She also refuses to do Total Nude Scholastic's Week. Searching for advice she goes to her friend and fellow idol Yui.

Yui advises her to take odd jobs such as commercials and modeling work. That way she can both pay back her agency and avoid having to do Total Nude Scholastic's Week. So Haruka announces to the media that although she is not returning to her idol group Tears she will continue her work as a public figure. She doesn't know what's in store for her however as the jobs which are available to her are increasingly humiliating.
translation:
[url=/v12936]Zenra Toukou Shuukan Chijoku no Sanshuukan[/url] 的替代重述。退出偶像团体Tears Haruka后，她发现自己陷入了困境。由于违反合同，她现在欠她的经纪公司很多钱。此外，她的学校要求她偿还三年来她没有承诺参加“全裸学术周”的费用。遥很绝望，面临考验，她无法承诺重返偶像。她还拒绝参加“全裸学术周”。为了寻求建议，她向她的朋友兼偶像同伴Yui寻求建议。

由依建议她从事广告和模特等零工。这样她既可以偿还她的代理费用，又可以避免参加“全裸学术周”。因此Haruka向媒体宣布，虽然她不会重返偶像团体Tears，但她将继续作为公众人物的工作。然而，她不知道等待着她的是什么，因为她可以从事的工作越来越丢脸。
